title: Get Down Fishing Charters

services.name: Tuna Fishing
services.desc: We believe we are one of the finest Snapper Fishing Charters in the Cocoa Beach, Florida area. In fact, if we had a forte', this would be it! Anglers love fishing for Snapper because they fight hard and are delicious to eat. On this fishing trip you and your group will target reef fish hanging around natural and artificial structure. We offer Cocoa Beach fishing charters for Mangrove, Lane, Vermillion Snapper & Red Snapper. This is an excellent fishing trip for families with smaller children. Call Get Down Charters today to bag some delicious Snapper on your next Port Canaveral Sportfishing Adventure! services.name: Dolphin fish
services.desc: Cobia is another popular option for Canaveral area anglers. Much like Dolphin, Cobia are a fast growing pelagic species known for their strength, stamina and excellent table fare. services.name: Sailfish Charters
services.desc: are a popular trip off Cocoa Beach, Florida. While sailfish are available year round, the best numbers occur during December and January. As winter approaches, Sailfish migrate South following schools of bait fish. The sailfish bite after a cold front during the winter months can be phenomenal.

blurb: Guests spend the day fishing aboard a 32' Prowler charter boat from Port Canaveral near Cocoa Beach on Florida's Space Coast. The charters offer access to deep sea sport fishing on Florida's East Central Atlantic coast. The boat is Coast Guard licensed and accommodates groups up to 6.
